credit.name: Virginia Major Business Facility Job Tax Credit
credit.summary: State income tax credit for companies establishing or expanding a major business facility in Virginia and creating 25+ qualifying full-time jobs. Applied against Virginia corporate income tax liability.

thresholds._note: The 25-job threshold applies to facility expansions. New major facility establishments (greenfield) may qualify at 50+ jobs. Prototype uses the 25-job expansion threshold.

benefit._note: $1,000 per qualifying net new job, applied in the year the jobs are created. Carryforward of 10 years for unused credit.
